basis: Cumulative underlying cash deficit (minus the underlying cash balance), Australian Government general government sector; positive is a deficit

sources.title: Monthly Financial Statements, aggregates monthly profiles
sources.attribution: Source: Department of Finance, Monthly Financial Statements, via data.gov.au. Licensed under CC BY 3.0 AU.

notes: Only months whose column is the 2026-27 Budget profile are included; actuals substituted by Finance ("Where there was no Budget profile published for the month, the actuals figure is used"), MYEFO and revised Budget profiles are excluded so one vintage is shown.

Status is "available" only when all twelve months (July to June) of the same Budget profile are published. Finance adds each month's profile with that month's statement, never publishes a June profile, and substitutes actuals where no profile exists, so this file is normally "partial".

Values are Finance year-to-date underlying cash balances with the sign reversed and converted to A$ billion; no interpolation or division of an annual forecast. Publication date is the Finance data release; the forecast vintage is the Budget.
